findings.statement: JAK-STAT pathway activity is increased in inflamed UC mucosa in all eight cohorts, with none decreased; this is the pathway already targeted by JAK inhibitors. [type=pathway_activity; source=ANALYSIS:pathways; cohorts_up=8]

TNFa pathway activity is increased in inflamed mucosa in all eight cohorts (NFkB likewise reaches the top t values); this is the axis of anti-TNF therapy, so it is robust but already drugged and not specific. [type=pathway_activity; source=ANALYSIS:pathways; cohorts_up=8]

Inferred STAT3 TF activity is up in all eight cohorts, strongest in GSE193677. [type=tf_activity; source=ANALYSIS:pathways; per_cohort.GSE193677.t=20.6] Many other TFs (AP1, CEBPD, ATF family) are equally replicated, so TF activity alone does not single out a target.

Negative result: the Androgen pathway is not consistent, being up in only two cohorts and down in others, whereas EGFR, Hypoxia, MAPK, PI3K, TGFb, NFkB, TNFa and JAK-STAT are up in all eight. [type=pathway_activity; source=ANALYSIS:pathways; cohorts_up=2] Broad pathway activation therefore mostly reflects generic inflammation.

In the Gubatan single-cell data CXCL8 from neutrophil states (Neutrophil CXCR4, Neutrophil OSM) is co-expressed with CXCR2 on other neutrophil states, an autocrine/paracrine neutrophil recruitment loop; the Neutrophil CXCR4 to Neutrophil pair increased vs uninflamed mucosa. [type=cell_communication; source=ANALYSIS:communication; log2_change=2.755] Co-expression only, not proof of signalling.

Neutrophil CXCL8 also reaches ACKR1 endothelial cells (venular endothelium, a leukocyte-trafficking site); this pair rose in inflamed mucosa. [type=cell_communication; source=ANALYSIS:communication; log2_change=1.991] ACKR1 is an atypical chemokine receptor that presents chemokine rather than signalling classically.

CXCR2 ranks first in the convergence ranking: meta-analysis log2FC up in eight of eight cohorts [gene=CXCR2; type=expression_meta; source=DATASET:META; layer=rna; log2fc=2.814], with genetic association and clinical-stage antagonists (navarixin, reparixin, ladarixin, SX-682). Not established in UC; the neutrophil CXCL8-CXCR2 axis is drugged only in other indications.

Cell-source caveat: in Gubatan, neutrophils make nearly all CXCR2 transcripts in inflamed mucosa [gene=CXCR2; type=sc_summary; source=DATASET:SCP259; neutrophil_share_inflamed=0.965], whereas Smillie (no neutrophils captured) assigns it to T/NK and does not replicate. The tissue increase therefore reflects neutrophil infiltration, not a change in resident cells.

CXCL8 is mostly myeloid in Smillie (macrophages), but when neutrophils are included they account for most transcripts. [gene=CXCL8; type=sc_summary; source=DATASET:SCP259; neutrophil_share_inflamed=0.873] Neutrophils are thus the main sender of the leading chemokine signal; antibodies against IL-8 (ABX-IL8, adakitug) are only phase 2.

IL1B from monocyte-derived macrophages and Neutrophil OSM is paired with IL1R2 on neutrophil states; the pair to Neutrophil CXCR4 rose in inflamed mucosa. [type=cell_communication; source=ANALYSIS:communication; log2_change=2.059] IL1R2 is a decoy receptor, so this co-expression may be a brake rather than an activating circuit; IL-1 blockade (canakinumab) is approved elsewhere but not in UC.

Negative result: the neutrophil OSM to IL6ST on LP fibroblasts circuit is weak and not increased; Neutrophil OSM to LP fibroblast changed by [type=cell_communication; source=ANALYSIS:communication; log2_change=-0.709] vs uninflamed mucosa. The Neutrophil PADI4 pair, though new, has a low score [type=cell_communication; source=ANALYSIS:communication; score_inflamed=86.523]. OSM is up in tissue and has no drug, but a neutrophil-to-fibroblast route is not supported here.

CHI3L1 is a strongly and consistently increased gene [gene=CHI3L1; type=expression_meta; source=DATASET:META; layer=rna; log2fc=4.8746] with no drug listed (like AQP9, DUOX2, CXCL1, MMP10), so it is an undrugged candidate or biomarker, but with no genetic support.

caveats: Ligand-receptor scores are co-expression of mean CP10K, not proof of signalling; Gubatan is a single dataset.
PROGENy and CollecTRI activities are inferred from target genes in bulk biopsies and mix epithelial, stromal and infiltrating immune changes.
Smillie has no neutrophils, so cell-source shares differ between datasets.
Integrin (vedolizumab) and IL-23 axes were not queried individually in this run.
The communication tool returns top pairs only; an inflammatory fibroblast receiver for neutrophil cytokines was not shown beyond OSM.
